sealed.statement: Authenticated INSTALL SERVICE establishes one immutable bindable Artifact declaration identity consisting of package_id plus the digest of its exact canonical normalized manifest; catalog-owned reads fail closed on OCI-digest ambiguity or manifest corruption, schema-v1 packages are explicitly non-bindable, and the prerequisite creates neither Binding nor runtime declarations.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

EXTEND the existing ServiceLifecycleCommandOwner -> ServiceInstallCatalogOwner -> service_packages.normalized_manifest path. The catalog owner alone derives and validates the bindable identity; do not add an artifact registry, package table, manifest validator, or lifecycle ingress.

Canonical bindable identity is packageId plus manifestDigest, where manifestDigest is sha256 of the exact canonical normalized_manifest bytes already stored immutably for that package. OCI artifactDigest remains payload identity and must never select one declaration when multiple package rows share it.

Derive manifestDigest from the existing immutable normalized_manifest column instead of adding a denormalized column or a new system-table migration. A typed catalog read must verify canonical JSON, the digest, package projections, and the resolved artifact fields before returning an analyzable v2 declaration.

Catalog-owned resolution by packageId plus manifestDigest returns the exact normalized v2 manifest and exports. Schema v1 returns artifact_not_analyzable; a mismatched or malformed stored manifest returns corrupt_record; digest-only resolution across differing manifests returns ambiguous_artifact_digest rather than a row chosen by ordering.

This prerequisite creates no Binding owner, Binding table, Binding schema, service_definitions row, runtime activation, or Cell. It only establishes the immutable catalog identity that the later Binding Quest may reference.

The deterministic scenario must prove authenticated SQL INSTALL SERVICE persists the canonical manifest bytes from which the catalog derives manifestDigest; two v2 manifests with the same OCI digest but different exports remain distinct, resolvable package identities while digest-only lookup fails closed.

Proof covers catalog projection and typed lookup, canonical-order stability, v1 rejection, malformed and digest-mismatched durable state, ambiguous OCI digest resolution, idempotent replay, absence of Binding/runtime writes, a static single-owner guard, and red-on-revert engagement.

claim: Adversarial review found that one verified OCI digest may back multiple installed normalized manifests because package identity includes manifest plus tenant while artifact_digest is non-unique and signatures cover only payload digest; canonical Binding targets must therefore pin package_id plus manifest_digest.
rulesOut: Persist artifact_digest#export as canonical Binding identity or choose a matching service_packages row by ordering.

rulesOut: Store statement-scoped call or pushdown invocations as ephemeral Binding rows.
